title: Fragmented Guides — devx TODO + micro-playbook
content:
Context:
Quick personal log + micro-playbook for triaging small doc/tut issues in the SDK and sample apps. This lives here because I want a lightweight place to dump fragmented fixes and rally a couple of folks for quick PRs. Not polished — lots of TODOs and act-as-checklist items.

Goals (short-term):
- Reduce friction for first-time users by fixing 5 small, high-impact doc bits in the next sprint.
- Have three runnable sample apps with clear README prompts (one for JS, one for Python, one for Docker/private endpoint).
- Create a minimal acceptance checklist so reviewers know when a doc change is done.

Quick triage rubric (for micro-fixes):
1) Impact: how many new users would be blocked or confused? (high/med/low)
2) Effort: single-line edit / small snippet / full tutorial rewrite
3) Test: runnable in < 10 mins on default free credits? (yes/no)
4) Owner: assign and ship in PR within 48hrs for low-effort fixes

Immediate items (prioritized):
- [ ] JS quickstart: missing note about NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED when testing against self-signed local proxy. Impact: med. Effort: 10m. Owner: Alex R. Steps: add one paragraph and example env var export. Test: run sample with localproxy flag.
- [ ] Python SDK example: token parameter named "api_key" in README but SDK expects "token". This broke a user in #support. Impact: high. Effort: 15m. Owner: me. Acceptance: README code snippet runs end-to-end. Linked PR: gh #412.
- [ ] Docker sample: image tag pinned to experimental build (v0.3.0-rc). Replace with stable tag and add note about GPU vs CPU fallback. Owner: Ben C. Effort: 20m. Test: build on CI with --platform linux/amd64.
- [ ] Tutorial step numbering mismatch: step 4 refers to creating an API key but the UI moved it under Security -> Tokens. Update text + add screenshot. Owner: Maya P. Effort: 40m (screenshot capture + alt text).

Micro-playbook: how to fix and ship a small doc issue (steps to follow)
- Create an issue in GitHub examples repo with labels: docs, low-effort, reproduce-if-needed.
- Add reproduction steps (copy-pasteable).
- Draft a one-paragraph change in the README.md and a minimal code snippet.
- Run the example locally for the platform (JS/Python/Docker). Note the exact commands used.
- Open PR referencing GH issue and this Drive note: CONFW-DEVX-4231 for context.
- Add acceptance checklist in PR description (see below).
- Request review from one reviewer + one eng owner if code snippet changed.

Acceptance checklist (copy into PR description):
- [ ] README text updated with exact command and expected output
- [ ] Code snippet runs locally in < 10 mins and produces sample output
- [ ] No broken links and correct route names (verify two hops)
- [ ] If UI changed, include single screenshot and alt text for accessibility
- [ ] PR includes a short why-this-matters note for release notes

Notes / testing commands I keep using (copyable):
- JS quickstart run (node 20):
  NODE_ENV=dev 
  NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 
  node examples/js/quickstart.js 

- Python venv quick check:
  python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r examples/python/requirements.txt && python examples/python/hello_redwood.py

- Docker local build for sample app:
  docker build -t rw-sample:local examples/docker && docker run --rm -e RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY rw-sample:local

Common gotchas to cover in docs (brain dump):
- API errors showing model-compatibility warnings (explain fallback behavior).
- Model alias vs model id confusion (many docs use alias; include note about pinning version).
- Avoid deep copy-paste of full JSON outputs in README — include trimmed expected output and link to raw example file.
- State OS-specific notes (Apple M1/M2 users see slightly different install needs — include brew caveat).

Ideas for small sample apps (quick to add):
- Local echo bot (JS) that demonstrates streaming responses and reconnects (15m).
- Python batch-embeddings example with CSV input and minimal pandas steps (20m).
- Docker + AWS Private Endpoint demo: show how to point to a VPC endpoint (45m).

Unresolved questions / decisions needed:
- Do we want to standardize snippet headers? (e.g., "# copy and paste") — vote needed from docs team.
- Screenshot policy: do we prefer PNGs or WebP in repo? PNG for now for cross-compat.
- Where to surface Node TLS workaround — inline or troubleshooting section?

Slack nudge templates (for quick reviewers):
- "Hey @<name>, small README fix in gh #412 — needs a quick run-through. Can you sanity-check the snippet? Should be 5 mins. Thanks!"

Log of recent attempts (timestamps):
- 2026-03-11 09:12 — repro'd Python token mismatch; created GH issue and added minimal snippet.
- 2026-03-11 15:40 — tried JS quickstart under localproxy, hit TLS error; added env var note.
- 2026-03-12 11:05 — Docker tag fix proposed in branch docker-stable-223. CI currently failing on cross-platform build.

Low-effort patch template (copy into PR body):
Title: docs: fix <short description>
Body: problem, reproduction steps, change, how tested, linked issue(s)

Final note to self: keep these entries micro-focused. If it grows beyond ~6 edits, it becomes a proper doc project and should move to product backlog with a PRD. For now: ship fast, test quickly, and keep acceptance checklist in PRs.

-- Sofia
